implementation: Exact source-square arithmetic from packages/ui/src/lib/friends-galaxy-avatar-crop.ts: clamp center/zoom, side=min(width,height)/zoom, clamp origin, draw into256px canvas, display circularly at220px and48px.

crops.visibleReview: One central pale-yellow Sarracenia alata flower fills the circle. The curved pedicel and hanging petals identify a flower rather than a pitfall leaf. A second flower is mostly outside the crop. At 48 pixels the pendulous form and light color remain legible; droplets are an adult-size detail, not an essential identity cue.

Ribbed, spiny green cactus surface crosses the circle diagonally; a single open white flower and blue sky preserve the subject at 48 pixels. It is one visible arm, not an ambiguous choice between cactus individuals. No face is fabricated.
